description: Timed click-through for the recorded demo. The front end's autoplay mode (?autoplay=45) replays these steps so every take is identical. Times are seconds from start. A step with a "cuts" list runs only in those cuts; a step without one runs in all three.

steps.say: Home health was denied. The insurer says the record does not show the patient is homebound.

steps.note: Letter tab, denial reason highlighted (DL p1 L12-13).
Requirement rows resolve one at a time, about 300 ms apart, then the banner slides in.

steps.say: Appealio breaks the policy into requirements and links each one to the exact lines in the record.
steps.note: Record tab jumps to p5 L10-11. Key phrases highlighted.

steps.say: For homebound status, nothing qualifies. The form section was left blank. So it says evidence missing. It does not write around the gap.
steps.note: Missing-evidence card opens with 3 closest passages.
Record tab jumps to p5 L16, dashed gray outline on the blank form field.

steps.say: The same policy covers home care in place of a facility stay, and the record supports all three conditions.
steps.note: Banner button. Alternative group expands, 3 of 3 supported.

steps.say: Including cost: 4,350 dollars at home against 10,400 in a facility.
steps.note: Record tab jumps to p6 L14-15, both cost figures highlighted.

steps.say: The draft says only what the record shows. Every sentence links back. Staff review and submit.
steps.note: Draft panel pulses; hover the citation chip on the cost sentence.

steps.say: And when the record does not support any route, it says that too.
Four of six weeks of therapy documented. No alternative basis. Next step: get the missing records.
steps.note: Partial card with the quantity check: 4 of 6 weeks.

cut_notes.30: Compress by dropping the 10.0 step and shortening holds: 0, 2, 4, 9 (R3), 12 (near miss), 16 (use_basis), 19 (A3-E1), 24 (draft), 30 (end). The front end should scale the shared steps to fit the cut length.
cut_notes.45: The default. One case, three beats: linked evidence, honest gap, alternative basis.
cut_notes.60: Adds case C-4420 to show the system declining to recommend an appeal.
